title: Apple to unveil new MacBook Pro models on October 28
description: Apple has announced its second special event for October, where it is expected to unveil the rumored touchscreen MacBook Pro. The company recently unveiled the HomeView, HomePod mini 2, a new Apple TV 4K, and several smart home products. title: Karbonn Rebel 5G is coming soon "for people who see past the hype"
description: Who remembers Karbonn? The Indian brand is preparing a comeback in the smartphone space, having spent the last five years or so in a state of hibernation. But that will end soon. Unfortunately, the page doesn’t reveal any specs right now, but it does say things like "status isn't a specification", "style that stands out", "all of the phone, none of the price shock", and "don't follow, just rebel". description: The upcoming Realme C01 - not to be confused with the Realme C1 from 2018 - was recently spotted on certification platforms in Malaysia and the UAE with the model number RMX5399, and now a premature listing by a Vietnamese retailer reveals its official specs, images, and pricing, even though it's not available to buy yet. title: DCS: the Huawei Enjoy 100 Pro Max will have a bigger battery than its predecessor
description: Back in March, Digital Chat Station reported that the then-upcoming Huawei Enjoy 90 Pro Max would have an 8,500mAh battery. This leak was confirmed a few days later when Huawei made the Enjoy 90 series official. Now the leakster has the details for the next generation of Enjoy models. The Huawei Enjoy 100 Pro Max will have an 8,800mAh battery (typical capacity, rated capacity will be 8,560mAh), according to DCS. This is a 300mAh upgrade over its predecessor. description: Last week we came across an EPREL listing for the upcoming Motorola Moto G47 Power, revealing its battery capacity, and we now have official-looking renders of the device alongside more of its key specs. Unsurprisingly, the Moto G47 Power looks a lot like the regular Moto G47, though at least one of its colorways is new, with a turquoise green color. The second one is the same black shade as before. description: If you thought the leaked European prices for vivo's X500 Pro and X500 Pro Max, or Oppo's Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max were high, then you probably won't be ready for this. title: Motorola's wide Razr Flex hits Geekbench with a surprising chipset
description: Last month, Motorola's upcoming wide foldable smartphone finally got a leaked name - it will allegedly be called the Razr Flex. This has now been confirmed through a Geekbench listing. Apparently, someone in possession of a prototype Razr Flex decided to run Geekbench 6.7.1 on it, thus confirming the name (as much as such a run can, of course - things like this can be faked). The benchmark run also revealed that the Razr Flex is powered by the Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 SoC, which is notable because past rumors have claimed it would have the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 instead. description: The Galaxy S27 series is shaping up to be a turning point for Samsung’s flagship line. Previous rumors suggest Samsung will usher in a new design for its Galaxy S27 Pro and Ultra models while still offering the Galaxy S27 and larger-screen Galaxy S27+ as its more affordable entries. A new leak from IceUniverse gives us a fresh new look at cases for all four S27 models, and it seems the Pro and Ultra design is here to stay. title: The extra rugged Crosscall Core X7 surfaces at a French retailer, followed by a rugged tablet
description: One rugged phone and one rugged tablet have surfaced on French retailer AMG Pro, which focuses on selling tactical equipment. They come from Crosscall – another French company. The Crosscall Core X7 is a rugged handset that can survive submersion up to 2m of water for 30 minutes (IPX8 rating) – and this includes salt water, which most IP rated phones avoid. The phone is also dust tight (IP6X) and resists hot water jets (IP69K). title: India smartphone shipments drop 26% in Q3 to the lowest level since 2016
description: According to a new report by Omdia, India's smartphone shipments fell by 26% to 35.8 million units in the third quarter (July to September) compared to the same period last year. Thus, Q3 2026 saw the lowest smartphone shipments since 2016, despite the start of the festive season. Higher prices and cautious consumer spending were to blame, unsurprisingly, and the latter is most likely caused by the former, so these aren't even really two reasons. Samsung regained the top spot for the first time since Q1 2024, shipping 6.7 million units, for about 19% of the market. Its top sellers were...

description: HMD could soon add a new variant to its Vibe2 series. A tipster has shared the full set of specifications and renders of an upcoming HMD Vibe2 Max. According to the leak, the HMD Vibe2 Max will sport a 6.78-inch LCD display with support for Full-HD+ resolution, 1,500 nit peak brightness, and a 120Hz refresh rate. The handset is said to be powered by the Unisoc T9100 chipset, paired with up to 8GB of RAM and 256GB of storage. description: Honor is unveiling the Win2 series in China on October 21, and now a tipster on Weibo has shared specs for all three phones in the family - the Win2, the Win2 RT, and the Win Turbo2. description: The Galaxy S26 series arrived late – the S24 generation was unveiled in mid-January and launched in late January, while the S25 generation was announced in late January and launched in early February. description: Xiaomi teased the arrival of the Redmi K100 in China last week. The company has now announced the phone’s launch date and revealed its key specs and design. description: Samsung’s latest F-series smartphone is now official in India with the launch of the Galaxy F70. This is the third entry in the F70 series, following the Galaxy F70e from February and the Galaxy F70 Pro, which launched in August. The new Galaxy F70 is the midpoint in the F-series and features plenty of similarities with last year’s Galaxy A17. description: Apple’s iPhone Duo went up for pre-order last week, with sales and deliveries set to begin later this week. Ahead of the launch, Apple has published the EU energy label for the foldable iPhone, revealing its battery capacity and endurance ratings. The official energy label lists a 4,883mAh lithium-ion battery for the iPhone Duo, which is split into two. According to the energy label, the iPhone Duo offers a rated battery endurance of 51 hours and 30 minutes per cycle. title: Honor Watch 6 review
description: Welcome to our Honor Watch 6 review. I know, I know, we're a little late with this one. Okay, maybe a lot late, but in our defense, some of that tardiness comes from battery testing a watch with more than a month's worth of endurance .(or so Honor promised). That may be the Honor Watch 6's key selling point, and for good reason: charging your smartwatch once a month is about as close to having a regular watch as you can get.
